text:
Your best competitor isn't taking your customers.

Your fastest one is.

A buyer fills 3 enquiry forms on a Tuesday night.
One business replies in 5 minutes.
One replies next morning.
One calls on Thursday.

Guess who gets the visit.

It's rarely about who has the better product. At the enquiry stage, the buyer can't tell yet. They can only tell who answered.

What fast looks like without hiring a night shift:
→ Form or ad lead lands
→ Instant WhatsApp reply with the useful thing (price sheet, slots, brochure)
→ The right salesperson gets an alert
→ No call in 15 minutes? The manager gets an alert

Speed is the cheapest competitive advantage most teams never measure.

Do you know your average first-reply time? Most owners I ask don't.
